workData.title: Aww
workData.subTitle: Revamped Aww’s design system and e-commerce site, strengthening brand identity and increasing average order value by 140% while boosting customer engagement.

content.text: As the Art Director for Aww, a travel product company, I led product design and art direction to rebuild their design system, enhance the e-commerce site, and establish a cohesive brand identity. The goal was to strengthen their brand image and connect with their target audience while maintaining consistency across all channels and media.
The challenge was to unify the brand’s visual identity and improve the user experience of their e-commerce platform to better align with the company’s vision and target audience.
A consistent and well-defined design direction would strengthen the brand’s identity and improve customer recognition.
Enhancing the UI/UX of the e-commerce platform would drive higher engagement, traffic, and sales.
Revamping the social media strategy with cohesive visuals and messaging would boost brand visibility and customer loyalty.

I redefined the brand’s core design concepts through extensive client discussions, creating a unified system for their logos, fonts, and color schemes. I also crafted a new slogan to reflect the brand’s overarching voice.
I overhauled the UI/UX of their e-commerce platform, ensuring a seamless and engaging shopping experience that aligned with the new brand identity.
I developed a comprehensive social media strategy, updating content and imagery to create a cohesive online presence that aligned with the brand’s voice and vision.
I directed advertisement photography and filming, ensuring all visuals consistently reflected the brand’s identity and vision.
: The redesigned e-commerce site and cohesive branding led to a significant increase in both website traffic and sales.
: The unified design system became the foundation for all marketing and promotional efforts, strengthening brand recognition and appeal.
: The updated social media strategy and cohesive visuals improved customer engagement and loyalty.
: Establishing a consistent design system across all platforms and media is critical for strengthening brand recognition.
: Engaging in detailed discussions with the client ensured the design reflected their vision and goals.
: Aligning the e-commerce platform, social media, and advertising under a unified brand identity creates a seamless and impactful customer experience.
This project highlighted the importance of combining strategic branding with thoughtful design to create a lasting and impactful presence in a competitive market.

next.title:
ONLIVE
Studio/blog
next.subTitle: Designed the ONLINE Studio platform and blog, creating a seamless UX/UI and expert verification system that fostered trust and collaboration between music professionals and freelancers.

content.text: I led the design system and product design for ONLINE Studio, a platform supporting music production artists and freelancers. I was responsible for designing the website and blog, delivering intuitive and clear UX and UI to enhance connections between professionals and freelancers while fostering a collaborative and creative environment for music production.

ONLINE Studio connects professional musicians, producers, arrangers, and engineers with freelancers. With a rigorous screening process for experts, the platform offers users a trustworthy and user-friendly space to create projects and collaborate seamlessly with professionals.

ONLINE Studio was designed to connect music production professionals with those who need their expertise, encouraging creative collaboration. The platform was structured to allow users to easily create projects and receive support from professionals.
A rigorous screening process for professionals would enhance the platform’s credibility.
Simplifying project creation and consultation features would improve user accessibility and promote collaboration.
Intuitive and consistent UI/UX design would maximize the user experience.
I established a consistent brand design system that unified the website and blog, ensuring coherence and reliability across all touchpoints.
I designed an intuitive and user-friendly UX that allows users to easily search for professionals and create projects.
To reflect ONLINE Studio’s unique atmosphere, I incorporated freeform layouts and collage techniques, creating a distinctive visual identity.
I implemented a rigorous screening process for professionals, ensuring that only verified experts were registered, building trust between users and the platform.
The project boosted user engagement and trust with intuitive UX/UI and a rigorous verification system, fostering creative collaboration within the music production community.

It highlighted the importance of building trust through expert certification systems and demonstrated how simple processes, combined with creative design and functional UX, can improve accessibility and user satisfaction.
This project successfully enhanced collaboration in the music community by building trust, encouraging creativity, and delivering an exceptional user experience.
